title: How are you?
summary: Ask how someone is, say how you are, thank people and ask simple questions.
intro: كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ is literally 'how is your condition?'. Most people answer بِخَيْر، الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه (fine, thank God). Today's question words are كَيْفَ, أَيْنَ, مَنْ and هَلْ. New letters: س ش ص ض, including two of the 'heavy' emphatic sounds.
objectives: Ask a man or a woman how they are
Say that you are fine, or tired
Thank someone and answer a thank-you
Use the question words كَيْفَ, أَيْنَ, مَنْ and هَلْ

realLife.title: A tired friend
realLife.story: It is Thursday morning. Sami looks tired after a long night of studying, and he has brought a friend from Jordan to class. Daniel and Layla practise asking how everyone is.

sentences.en: Are you all right? (to a woman)

mistakes.why: hal is only for yes/no questions. Never put it before another question word.

dialogue.title: How is everyone today?
dialogue.culture: الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه (praise be to God) is said by Muslims, Christians and non-religious people alike. It is simply the normal way to say you are well.

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر يَا لَيْلَى! كَيْفَ حَالُكِ الْيَوْم؟
lines.en: Good morning, Layla! How are you today?

lines.ar: صَبَاحُ النُّور! أَنَا بِخَيْر، الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه. وَأَنْتَ؟
lines.en: Good morning! I am fine, thank God. And you?

lines.ar: أَنَا بِخَيْر أَيْضًا، شُكْرًا. أَيْنَ سَامِي؟
lines.en: I am fine too, thanks. Where is Sami?

lines.ar: سَامِي هُنَاكَ، عِنْدَ الْبَاب. هُوَ تَعْبَان قَلِيلًا.
lines.en: Sami is over there, by the door. He is a little tired.

lines.ar: مَرْحَبًا يَا سَامِي! كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ هَلْ أَنْتَ بِخَيْر؟
lines.en: Hello, Sami! How are you? Are you all right?

lines.ar: أَهْلًا يَا دَانْيَال. أَنَا تَعْبَان، لٰكِنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰه.
lines.en: Hi, Daniel. I am tired, but I am fine, thank God.

lines.ar: مِسْكِين! مَنْ هٰذَا مَعَكَ يَا سَامِي؟
lines.en: Poor thing! Who is this with you, Sami?

lines.ar: هٰذَا صَدِيقِي يُوسُف. هُوَ طَالِب جَدِيد مِنَ الْأُرْدُنّ.
lines.en: This is my friend Yusuf. He is a new student from Jordan.
Hello! I am Yusuf. Nice to meet you all!
Nice to meet you, Yusuf! How are you?

lines.ar: بِخَيْر، شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا. أَنْتُمْ لُطَفَاء جِدًّا!
lines.en: Fine, thank you very much. You are all very kind!

lines.ar: عَفْوًا يَا يُوسُف! أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا فِي الصَّفّ.
lines.en: You're welcome, Yusuf! Welcome to our class.

reading.title: A text message
reading.ar: مَرْحَبًا يَا لَيْلَى! كَيْفَ حَالُكِ؟ أَنَا بِخَيْر. أَيْنَ أَنْتِ الْآن؟
reading.en: Hello Layla! How are you? I am fine. Where are you now?

quiz.prompt: Someone asks how you are. You are fine. What do you say?
Which letter is the emphatic (heavy) s?
In the dialogue, where is Yusuf from?

completion: Well done! You can ask how people are, answer, and say thank you. You now know fifteen letters.
